headline: Iran Says Strait of Hormuz Reopening Possible Under Reasonable Terms
summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that reopening the Strait of Hormuz could be possible if Washington accepts reasonable international legal conditions, as Donald Trump demands a permanent nuclear deal.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most vital energy bottleneck; disruptions to vessel traffic through the waterway can cause severe global crude supply shocks.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Potential terms to reopen the Strait of Hormuz directly shift global oil supply risk premiums.
